content: spring-ai-starter-typesafe 0.1.0 (Maven Central sources jar): TypeSafeAutoConfiguration is @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix=spring.ai.typesafe, name=api-key) at class level; bean method does Assert.state(StringUtils.hasText(apiKey)) -> a present-but-blank key (e.g. ${VAR:} unset) throws IllegalStateException during context refresh (app fails to start) despite comment claiming it declines. Starter POM depends on spring-boot-starter 4.0.7 and typesafe-java-sdk 0.1.0 (spring-web 7.0.8, tools.jackson databind 3.1.4); no Spring AI dependency. Bean clones context RestClient.Builder and sets JdkClientHttpRequestFactory readTimeout=spring.ai.typesafe.timeout (10s); no connect timeout set.
